questions.explanation: (a) Embarass -> Embarrass (double r, double s) = (iii). (b) Harrass -> Harass -> actually correct is Harass... no, Harass is also wrong. Correct: Harass (one r, double s). Wait - Harass has one r and one s? No: Harass = one r, one s is wrong. Correct = Harass (single r, single s). Actually the correct spelling is Harass (one r, two s's)... Let me verify: H-A-R-A-S-S = Harass. So Harrass (double r) -> Harass (single r) = (iv). (c) Occassion -> Occasion (single s) = (ii). (d) Posession -> Possession (double s at start) = (i).
